content.title: MediaAlpha (NYSE:MAX) Posts Better-Than-Expected Sales In Q3 CY2025
content.summary: Insurance customer acquisition platform MediaAlpha (NYSE:MAX) reported Q3 CY2025 results beating Wall Street’s revenue expectations, with sales up 18.3% year on year to $306.5 million. On the other hand, next quarter’s revenue guidance of $290 million was less impressive, coming in 1.3% below analysts’ estimates. Its non-GAAP profit of $0.40 per share was 8.2% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
